ACP subagent reporting made per connection after CI caught a generic ACP session reading 'reported, nothing running': engine-capability-matrix.ts adds an optional perConnection.unobservedReason on a declared subagent cell (ACP only), child-work-projection.ts and the Agents pane fall back to not-reported with it. This document's subagent/ACP claims were checked against those files; tests in child-work-projection, childWorkSelectors, AgentsWorkspacePane.childWork and orchestration-service pin it, fault-injected.
